name: causal local-window Fourier transfer
status: architecture intervention and corpus split amended from per-layer receptive-field algebra before any limited-window natural-training outcomes
amendment: After six uniform cells and before any natural-window outcome, clarified that attention_window is a per-layer mask. Added the algebraic effective-reach control; no empirical result motivated the change and the primary measured-uniform-fingerprint test is unchanged.
question: Does an architecture's CE response to exact Fourier characters under uniform inputs predict its learning penalty on unseen natural corpora when only its receptive field is changed?

measurement_protocol.reuse: identical transformer size, optimizer, token budget, data splits, validation chunks, and profile estimator

intervention.mask_semantics: In each layer, window w permits attention distances 0 through w-1; at a next-token prediction these are direct target lags 1 through w.
intervention.effective_reach_formula: 1 + n_layers * (w - 1); this is graph reach, not a claim that every function inside the reach is easy

uniform_character_probe.basis: real Walsh characters, parity of the selected binary lag coordinates
uniform_character_probe.hardness: median normalized held-out CE curve area over two seeds

dataset_fourier_features.energy_scope: positive exact-support nested-projection increments through degree two, normalized to unit mass within that scope
dataset_fourier_features.feature_freeze: all 48 by 3 feature rows are hash-locked after uniform probes and before limited-window natural training

natural_training.primary_target: delta_normalized_curve_area=A(D,w)-A(D,64); positive means the smaller window learned worse

models: window fixed effects plus unreachable_energy_fraction plus delta_uniform_overlap
analysis.primary_comparison: held-out relative RMSE improvement of delta_uniform_overlap model over window-fixed-effect baseline
analysis.mechanism_comparison: held-out incremental RMSE improvement from adding delta_uniform_overlap to the algebraic unreachable_energy_fraction; direct_far_energy_fraction is a diagnostic

bootstrap.resample: corpora within source stratum, retaining all three window rows

analysis.success: primary delta-overlap coefficient is positive and the confirmation bootstrap lower bound for RMSE improvement over window fixed effects is above zero
